source: Self-generated interop pin, not an oracle (D-68, D-208). Written by crates/uacrypt/tests/gen_secretstream_file_vectors.rs over crypto_secretstream::PushState. v1_0_3_8 is a real file from uacrypt 0.3.8 (tag v0.3.8) under the same key and the same (i*31+7) mod 256 plaintext as valid; short_non_final carries genuinely valid tags, so rejecting it proves the exact-8192 rule, not authentication. expect: ok | unsupported_version | bad_chunk_length | truncated | auth.
